mainEntity.name: How much does it cost to hire an employment discrimination lawyer?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of hiring an employment discrimination lawyer can vary. Many attorneys in this field work on a contingency fee basis, meaning their fee is a percentage of the financial recovery they achieve for you. If there is no recovery, you generally don't pay attorney fees. Some cases might involve an hourly fee or a hybrid arrangement. It's important to discuss fee structures during your initial consultation so you understand all potential costs, including litigation expenses, before proceeding with a legal claim.
